title: Last-mile operator scratchpad — T-0 to +03h
content:
Context: personal last-minute checklist for the release. Lightweight operator notes I keep on my laptop during T-0. Not for wide sharing — ephemeral reminders and quick command snippets.

Goals:
- Ship dedicated-routing improvements behind feature flag.
- No DB schema changes in this release (good).
- Keep canary at 5% for first 30m, then step to 25% if stable.

Quick timeline (local clock):
- T-60 (prep): ensure build artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-release/artifacts/2026-03-10/ ; confirm SHA: 9f3b7c2
- T-30: notify #release-ops and #sre-oncall with short summary (template below)
- T-10: open monitoring dashboard (Links in linked_artifacts) and set alert windows
- T-0: flip canary to 5% via rollout API, watch p50/p95 latency on serving-runtime
- T+30: roll to 25% if error budget < 0.1% and p95 within SLO
- T+60: if stable, roll to 100% in two steps: 60% then 100% separated by 5m
- T+180: run quick smoke tests and annotate release ticket

Pre-flight checklist (instant ticks):
- [ ] Artifacts present and SHA validated (s3 + CI log) — command: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-release/artifacts/2026-03-10/
- [ ] Terraform state lock released (ran tf unlock yesterday) — run: terraform state list | head
- [ ] Secrets/keys rotated? (no changes for this release)
- [ ] Canary routing config exists: route-id = r-serve-2026a
- [ ] Rollback playbook open and pinned in Slack channel
- [ ] On-call pager + backup contacts at hand (@sre-oncall, @infra-pager)

Backport / PRs to watch (small matrix):
- runtime PR #5812 — gating changes to batching selector (must be included in artifact)
- infra PR #744 — lb config tweak (already merged to release branch)
- serving-config PR #213 — config default for kv-cache-ttl=30s (ensure applied)
- NOTES: if any of these are missing, abort and escalate to Jordan asap (he has the cherry-pick privileges)

Quick commands (copy-paste):
- Promote canary to 5%: curl -XPOST "$ROLLOUT_API/api/v1/rollouts/r-serve-2026a/promote" -d '{"percent":5}' 
- Check p95: jq '.metrics.p95' <(curl -s "$MONITORING_API/runtime/serving/p95?window=5m")
- Rollback: curl -XPOST "$ROLLBACK_API/api/v1/rollouts/r-serve-2026a/rollback" -d '{"to": "release-2026-02-28"}'
- Tail logs: kubectl -n serving logs -l app=runtime -f --since=5m | grep "error" -n || true

What to watch (leading indicators):
- Tokenization heat: sudden spike in average tokens per request (means clients sent long prompts)
- KV cache miss ratio rising > 15% (could blow cost and latency)
- Throttles at API gateway: 429s trending up
- Model OOMs: check node /var/log/kern.log for OOM kills (pager will escalate if observed)

Communication templates (short):
- Pre-release (T-30) -> #release-ops: "Starting release: runtime routing changes. T-0 in 30m. Canary 5% for 30m, contact @Ava on call for issues. Linked: INF-4023, PR#5812"
- Rapid update (T+10) -> #release-ops: "Canary 5% — p95=180ms, errors 0.02%. Continuing. Watching KV cache miss=6%"
- Abort (if any red flags) -> #release-ops: "ABORTING release. Reason: <short reason>. Initiating rollback to release-2026-02-28. @sre-oncall please assist with traffic shift and DB checks."

Escalation contacts (order):
1) @sre-oncall (primary)
2) Jordan Kim — cherry-pick/prioritization (Slack: @jordank)
3) Ravi Singh — infra networking (Slack: @ravi.s)

Quick troubleshooting notes (past lessons):
- If p95 spikes but CPU% low: likely KV cache churn — check eviction patterns and restart warmers rather than runtime pods.
- If only one AZ shows increased errors: check LB health checks and node drain status; do not roll forward until AZ stabilized.
- Rolling forward after partial rollback creates split-brain flags in rollout API; always use rollout API to set a single desired percent.

Post-release stub (fill after T+180):
- Observed regressions (list)
- Any backports applied post-cutover (list PRs with reasons)
- Smoke test tickbox (include endpoint samples)
- Short blameless notes for postmortem if needed

Personals (quick reminders to self):
- Drink water, keep phone silent except Slack pings
- If I step away >10m, update channel with who is covering
- If things look weird and I hesitate, pause rollout and ask for 2min freeze

End — will copy relevant bits into INF-4023 once final.

Scratchpad markers: //TODOs inside here are ephemeral; delete after release.
